extracted.intended_audience: undergraduate physics and astronomy students and their advisers (college chapters)
extracted.subtask_description: Informational page describing Society of Physics Students membership, chapter activities, benefits (skills, publications, awards), and undergraduate internship placement focus. Aimed at recruiting and guiding students/advisers on participation and opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Membership eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Membership, through collegiate chapters, is open to anyone interested in the physical sciences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Three ways to join are offered: Individual, Discounted Group, or Chapter Membership. Membership targets not only physics majors but also students in astronomy, chemistry, computer science, engineering, and other fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter purpose and centrality
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapters are the heart of the SPS experience; they connect students to outreach, awards, scholarship opportunities, research, professional development opportunities, networking, and so much more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Every chapter is unique and pursues the activities that best serve its members, department, campus, and geographical setting. Chapters should tailor programming to local needs and member interests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter activity alignment
rubrics_metrics.description: Every chapter is individualized by the interests of its members, their physics and astronomy departments, and geographical setting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When designing chapter activities, prioritize those that best serve members, department, campus, and local community context rather than following a single template.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional skill development outcomes
rubrics_metrics.description: SPS helps build skills needed to flourish professionally, including effective communication, leadership experience, networking, research experiences, and outreach services to the campus and local communities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use SPS membership and chapter activities to develop these concrete professional competencies; these are presented as expected benefits and outcomes of participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internship program focus
rubrics_metrics.description: Our internship program places undergraduates in organizations that advance physics in policy, outreach, research, and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Internships are targeted at organizations advancing physics across policy, outreach, and research domains; students seeking internships should expect placements aligned with those areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Awards & scholarships availability
rubrics_metrics.description: We provide scholarships, research and travel grants, and outreach awards for individuals and chapters in physics and astronomy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Awards and scholarships are available both to individual students and to chapters; applicants should look for opportunities in scholarships, travel/research grants, and outreach awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication opportunities for members
rubrics_metrics.description: Members have opportunities to publish research in the Journal of Undergraduate Research in Physics and Astronomy (JURPA).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publishing is presented as a benefit of membership; undergraduate research suitable for JURPA is a pathway for members to disseminate work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Society memberships benefit
rubrics_metrics.description: By joining SPS you get free memberships to two physical science societies each year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an explicit recurring benefit of SPS membership and may factor into evaluation of membership value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Modes of joining
rubrics_metrics.description: There are three ways to join: Individual, Discounted Group or Chapter Membership.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Potential members should choose the mode that matches their situation (single student, group, or institutional chapter); further details are available via 'Get the Details'.
